## Summary

Describe the problem, the solution, and the user-visible or scientific impact.

Closes #

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated focused tests.
- [ ] Ran the testthat suite.
- [ ] Parsed all R source files.
- [ ] Built the Docker image when runtime dependencies changed.

## Scientific and data review

- [ ] Statistical assumptions and interpretation are documented where relevant.
- [ ] No patient, confidential, unpublished, or credential data is included.
- [ ] Example data is simulated or fully anonymised.

## Scope

- [ ] The pull request contains one coherent change.
- [ ] Documentation reflects changed behaviour.
- [ ] Breaking changes and migration steps are clearly identified.
